300.title: Poland to Hold Rates as Fuel-Price Cap Seen Cooling Inflation

300.body: Economics Central Banks Poland to Hold Rates as Fuel-Price Cap Seen Cooling Inflation Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift Gift this article Contact us: Provide news feedback or report an error Confidential tip? Send a tip to our reporters Site feedback: Take our Survey New Window Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift By Agnieszka Barteczko and Barbara Sladkowska October 7, 2026 at 4:00 AM UTC Bookmark Save Takeaways by Bloomberg AI Poland’s central bank is set to keep interest rates on hold for a seventh straight month as the government’s move to reduce fuel prices at the pump buys policymakers more time to assess inflation path. The Monetary Policy Council will hold its benchmark at 3.75% on Wednesday, according to all 34 economists surveyed by Bloomberg. The panel is expected to announce its decision before 4 p.m. in Warsaw, while Governor Adam Glapinski is scheduled to hold his monthly news conference at 3 p.m. on Thursday.

500.body: Facebook Linkedin Reddit Twitter Threads Bluesky Comment bubble icon Ajit Varma, Head of Firefox Firefox 157 landed on 29 September with Project Nova, the most significant visual overhaul since Proton in 2021, featuring new colours, icons, spacing, Compact Mode restored after community demand, and a consistent design language across desktop and mobile. But talking to Ajit Varma, Head of Firefox at Mozilla, the changes underneath - including an enterprise security beta, AI model choice built into the browser, and Anthropic auditing the codebase via a GitHub pull request - are where the real investment is going. In a wide-ranging conversation ahead of the FX 157 launch, he walked through Firefox's positioning around enterprise security, AI governance, open source integrity and the regulatory tailwinds that are driving mobile growth in Europe.

500.summary: Under oath, Google confirms three AI agent test escapes as OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta face NYC lawmakers By Brian Buntz | October 6, 2026 Jacob Coxon, a former pretraining researcher, was among the witnesses at the New York City Council’s Oct. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta testified together under oath Oct.
500.body: Under oath, Google confirms three AI agent test escapes as OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta face NYC lawmakers By Brian Buntz | October 6, 2026 Jacob Coxon, a former pretraining researcher, was among the witnesses at the New York City Council’s Oct. OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta testified together under oath Oct. One of the stories prompting the NYC hearing was the Hugging Face incident in July, in which OpenAI agents running inside a cybersecurity evaluation broke containment and hacked Hugging Face, an incident Sam Altman later called the company’s “worst accident” at Dreamforce . Alice Friend, Google’s director of AI and emerging tech policy, described three incidents involving Google’s agents “leaving a test environment and interacting with the real internet.” In those incidents, “the models stopped their activities as soon as they realized that they were interacting with live websites,” she added.
